content.comment_body: Hi, I have a [product_name] [article_no] without display and cannot switch from STOP to RUN mode. I used [product_name] V7 to create a simple program with one digital input and one digital output. The program downloads successfully, but the device stays in STOP (LED is red). Since there are no buttons or display, I don't see a way to change to RUN mode. The function in [product_name] is not supported by this [article_no] hardware. I also tried with [product_name] V6, but got the same result. How can I switch this [product_name] [article_no] without display to RUN mode? Do I need an older software version? Any advice is appreciated.
Have you tried using the standard toolbar and the 'change modes' button to set the [product_name] into RUN mode?
Yes, I tried that but received a message saying the function isn't supported. I think this feature wasn't available when the [article_no] was released.

I found this in the [document]: If there's a valid program in memory, the device will switch from STOP to RUN automatically when power is turned on. So, disconnect the programming cable and turn off power for about 20 seconds. When you reconnect power, the device should go into RUN mode automatically. Good luck!
That solved my issue. Thanks for the help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users of the [product_name] module without display face challenges switching their device to RUN mode after downloading a program via [product_name]. The remote RUN mode option in the software does not work with this hardware, which leads to confusion and makes users consider older software versions. The official documentation about using power cycling to activate RUN mode is not prominently highlighted, forcing users to seek external assistance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily switch their [product_name] module to RUN mode through [product_name], regardless of whether their module has a display or buttons.
